execution.exact_final_execution_commit: not separately recaptured in the supplied aggregate output
execution.code_lineage_note: canonical shared-architecture implementation introduced at 333394799cb473de2ba8f9c3c214e3c043f92364; later provenance-key compatibility changes do not alter training or evaluation metrics

protocol.sampling: ZeroUnlearn-compatible: forget from second half, retain from first half, seeded sampling

stage1.method: teacher-forced sensitive-token GA plus same-prompt non-sensitive GD
stage1.ga_loss: mean(log p_theta(y_sensitive | direct prompt, sensitive prefix)); minimized
stage1.gd_loss: KL(p_base(-y_sensitive) || p_theta(-y_sensitive)) after removing the sensitive token and renormalizing
stage1.restoration: reset the full vocabulary matrix to the base snapshot, then reapply only trained sensitive target_new rows

post_restore_change_matrix.support: only unique sensitive target_new token rows from the 50 direct forget requests
post_restore_change_matrix.non_sensitive_rows: exactly zero relative to base after restoration

stage2.selected_rows: sensitive target_new token IDs belonging to residual direct failures only
stage2.rank_selection: first ordered candidate with zero direct failures; if none, minimize (direct_failures, candidate_order, delta_norm)
stage2.scale_selection: smallest scale with zero direct failures; if none, minimize (direct_failures, scale)
stage2.low_rank_parameterization: DeltaW_R = C @ B_r, C in R^(R x r), B_r in R^(r x 3072), with B_r fixed from SVD of active direct hidden states

full_change_matrix.support: R selected sensitive output rows; all other rows are zero

evaluation.ppl_text: join train['text'][:20] with spaces, tokenizer truncation to 100 input tokens
evaluation.aggregation: mean +/- sample standard deviation across 10 seeds

interpretation_note: This is the architecture-aligned canonical MCF run, not necessarily the numerically strongest historical MCF snapshot. Historical benchmark-specific SURE records remain in this folder for provenance.
